notes: A Lítačka 24-hour ticket costs 120 CZK (tram, metro and funicular). The centre is walkable. The AE bus to the airport costs 100 CZK. Use Bolt or Uber instead of taxis.
Summers are 25-30°C. Visit Charles Bridge before 7:30, book timed castle tickets, enjoy the beer gardens (Letná, Riegrovy) and go rafting in Krumlov. August is the busiest month.
Beer is 50-70 CZK (cheaper than water), goulash 200-250, svíčková 250, a croissant and coffee 100. Tip 10%. A cover charge is sometimes added to the bill.
Currency exchange offices often use a "0% commission" trick (bad rate). At ATMs, choose your own bank's rate. If you are offered payment in EUR, the rate is bad. You can pay by card everywhere.
The main castle circuit costs 450 CZK. Josefov is closed on Saturdays. Buy online tickets for the Sedlec Bone Church (no photography). Book the Krumlov bus (RegioJet) days ahead.
Trdelník is not Czech (it is Hungarian or Slovak) but it is tasty. Real Czech dishes: svíčková, vepřo knedlo zelo, smažený sýr (fried cheese), koláče (sweet pastries).

stops.name: Charles Bridge
stops.tips: A 14th-century bridge lined with 30 statues. It is empty before 8 am. Touch the statue of John of Nepomuk.

stops.name: Old Town Square
stops.tips: Týn Church and the Jan Hus monument. The Astronomical Clock performs every hour from 09:00 to 23:00 (the 12 apostles).

stops.name: Old Town Hall Tower
stops.tips: A tower with a lift and panoramic views over the square. No queues in the morning.

stops.name: Jewish Quarter Josefov
stops.tips: Old-New Synagogue, Old Jewish Cemetery (12,000 gravestones) and the Pinkas Synagogue. Closed on Saturdays.

stops.name: Lokál Dlouhá
stops.tips: Beer from the best Pilsner Urquell tank, plus svíčková (beef in cream sauce) and goulash. A classic Czech canteen.

backups.name: Klementinum
backups.tips: Baroque library and astronomical tower. Swap for Josefov.

stops.name: Prague Castle
stops.tips: The world's largest castle complex: St Vitus Cathedral (Mucha stained glass), the Old Royal Palace and Golden Lane (Kafka's No. 22). Arrive at the 09:00 opening, book a timed ticket in summer, and expect security checks at the gate.

stops.name: Malá Strana Walk
stops.tips: Marked houses along Nerudova Street, and the baroque St Nicholas Church (dome).

stops.name: U Modré Kachničky
stops.tips: The Blue Duck: goose and duck are Bohemian classics. In Malá Strana.

stops.name: Kampa Island & Museum
stops.tips: A park on a river island with David Černý's babies and the Kampa Museum (Kupka), 350 CZK.

stops.name: Petřín Hill Funicular & Tower
stops.tips: The funicular takes a tram ticket. The 63 m mini Eiffel Tower has 299 steps. Go for sunset.

backups.name: Café Savoy
backups.tips: A café from 1893 with a painted ceiling, in Malá Strana.

backups.name: Strahov Monastery Library
backups.tips: Baroque library and beer. Swap for Petřín.

stops.name: Vyšehrad
stops.tips: A hilltop fortress that predates Prague Castle. See the Slavín cemetery (Dvořák, Mucha), the Rotunda and river views. Free.

stops.name: Vinohradský Parlament
stops.tips: A Czech restaurant in Vinohrady. Try vepřo knedlo zelo (pork, dumplings and cabbage).

stops.name: Riegrovy Sady
stops.tips: A park beer garden with views of the castle. Sunset in summer.

stops.name: Žižkov Television Tower
stops.tips: Černý's climbing babies and a 93 m observation deck.

stops.name: U Slovanské Lípy
stops.tips: An old Žižkov pub with more than 10 tank beers and pork knuckle.

backups.name: Kavárna Slavia
backups.tips: A riverside café from 1884, opposite the National Theatre.

backups.name: National Museum
backups.tips: At the top of Wenceslas Square, with a dome. Swap for Žižkov.

stops.name: Sedlec Ossuary
stops.tips: 1 hour by train (Hlavní). Chandeliers and a coat of arms made from 40,000 skeletons (the Bone Church). Buy tickets online. No photography.

stops.name: St. Barbara's Cathedral
stops.tips: The Gothic cathedral of the silver miners. UNESCO-listed, with a terrace at the Jesuit College.

stops.name: Kutná Hora Historic Centre
stops.tips: Medieval streets, the Stone Fountain and the Italian Court (the mint).

stops.name: Dačický Kutná Hora
stops.tips: A medieval beer hall serving local beer and duck.

stops.name: Czech Museum of Silver Hrádek
stops.tips: Descend into a medieval silver mine (helmet and apron provided). Guided tour, then the train back.

backups.name: Karlštejn Castle
backups.tips: Charles IV's Gothic castle, 40 minutes by train. Swap for Kutná Hora (closed Mondays).

backups.name: Pivnice Dačický Bahçe
backups.tips: The garden of the same venue. Sausages.

stops.name: Letná Park Metronome
stops.tips: A metronome stands where the Stalin statue once was. Views of the bridges and a beer garden (summer).

stops.name: National Technical Museum
stops.tips: Aeroplanes, trains and vintage cars, in Letná.

stops.name: Holešovice Market Hall
stops.tips: Pražská tržnice: Vietnamese pho and Czech food stalls.

stops.name: DOX Centre for Contemporary Art
stops.tips: Contemporary art and a rooftop airship, in Holešovice.

stops.name: Stromovka Park
stops.tips: A former royal hunting park with ponds and a planetarium.

backups.name: Prague Zoo
backups.tips: One of Europe's best zoos (Troja). Swap for DOX and Stromovka.

stops.name: Český Krumlov Castle
stops.tips: RegioJet bus, 3 hours (Florenc, about 200 CZK, leave at 07:00). A UNESCO town in a bend of the Vltava with the country's second-largest castle. Tower 180 CZK, baroque theatre tour.

stops.name: Castle Garden Český Krumlov
stops.tips: Cascading gardens and a revolving auditorium theatre.

stops.name: Krčma v Šatlavské
stops.tips: A medieval dungeon tavern serving meat cooked over an open fire.

stops.name: Český Krumlov Old Town
stops.tips: Latrán and the square, plus the Egon Schiele Art Centrum (200 CZK).

stops.name: Vltava Rafting Krumlov
stops.tips: A 1-hour rubber boat ride through the town. The weirs are fun (May to September).

backups.name: Hluboká Castle
backups.tips: A white, Windsor-style castle. An alternative on the way to Krumlov.

stops.name: Wenceslas Square
stops.tips: The square of the 1989 Velvet Revolution. The National Museum stands at the top, and the upside-down horse hangs in Lucerna Passage.

stops.name: Havelské Tržiště
stops.tips: A market in the Old Town for souvenirs and fruit. Try Moser for Bohemian crystal.

stops.name: Café Louvre
stops.tips: A café from 1902 (Kafka, Einstein). Farewell breakfast and billiards.

stops.name: Hlavní Nádraží Airport Bus
stops.tips: The AE bus takes 35 minutes, or take the metro plus bus 119. Farewell.

backups.name: Trdelník Stand Old Town
backups.tips: Trdelník with ice cream (touristy but tasty). A farewell treat.

backups.name: Mucha Museum
backups.tips: Art nouveau posters. Swap for the market.
